stem: ![](asset:P000350-stem-1) Two blocks A and B of mass 1 kg and 2 kg respectively are connected by a string passing over a light frictionless pulley. Both the blocks are resting on a horizontal floor and the pulley is held such that string remains just taut. At moment t = 0, a time-dependent force F = 20 t newton starts acting on the pulley along vertically upward direction as shown in figure. Find the speed of block A at the instance block B leaves the ground.

assets.alt: Blocks A and B resting on the ground, joined by a string over a light pulley that is pulled upwards with force F = 20t.
